issues.title: research(ipmnist): reproduce L2-ER effective-rank regularization
issues.scope: Implement faithful L2-only, rank-only, and combined L2-ER arms in the current IPMNIST runner.

issues.title: research(plasticity): implement AdamO dynamical-isometry comparator
issues.scope: Implement AdamO with inert reductions, Jacobian/isometry diagnostics, and exact state/cost accounting.

issues.title: research(streaming): implement Intentional Updates controls
issues.scope: Implement batch-size-one supervised and TD/control Intentional Updates under matched update budgets.

issues.title: research(plasticity): implement bounded growing and elastic networks
issues.scope: Compare adaptive growth/pruning with fixed-capacity CBP under fixed peak-memory and final-size budgets.

issues.title: research(plasticity): implement continuous utility-scaled partial resets
issues.scope: Add utility-scaled pull-to-initialization with hard-reset, L2-init, utility-free, and mechanism-off reductions.

issues.title: research(plasticity): add NaP normalization-and-projection control

issues.title: research(plasticity): implement C-CHAIN churn-reduction comparator

issues.title: research(plasticity): evaluate low-cost activation and feature controls
issues.scope: Compare Smooth-Leaky activation, interval-wise dropout, and Deep Fourier Features independently.

issues.title: research(plasticity): implement noise-curvature scheduling comparator
issues.scope: Implement and cost the layerwise noise-curvature scheduler against fixed conditioning controls.

issues.title: research(diagnostics): prospectively evaluate optimization readiness
issues.scope: Freeze and prospectively test optimization-readiness predictions against rank, norm, gradient, and curvature baselines.

issues.title: research(streams): add gradual-change plasticity protocols
issues.scope: Add deterministic gradual input/output transitions alongside, without replacing, abrupt IPMNIST changes.

issues.title: research(ipmnist): audit and implement BiMU as a protocol-extended arm

issues.title: research(ipmnist): add AdaLin adaptive-linearity comparator

issues.title: research(ipmnist): add replay and frozen-feature ceiling controls
issues.scope: Add replay/in-context and RanDumb/RanPAC/PROL ceilings with replay, pretraining, and extractor costs charged.

issues.title: research(world-model): reproduce FTL Online Agent / Continual Bench

issues.title: research(world-model): add action-conditioned latent prediction lane

issues.title: research(world-model): establish Dreamer-family continual baselines

issues.scope: Separate architecture effects from web-video pretraining and define a no-imported-pretraining ASI ablation.
